intrabar.gap: an open through the protective stop exits at the open before funding or any target
intrabar.collision: if a non-gap stop and any target are both inside one unresolved 4h candle, the stop wins and no target is booked
intrabar.targets: after the stop is ruled out, favourable target levels execute in price order using the frozen taker slippage, fee and tick rules
intrabar.target_time: without finer ordered-trade evidence, a non-gap target is accounted at the 4h bar close; actual funding events earlier in that bar apply to the pre-target quantity

H1.partial_rounding: floor the requested partial quantity to stepSize; zero means no fill, no fee and no breakeven transition

H2.at_observation_boundary: right_censored_runtime_no_cap; INCOMPLETE; never force-close or exclude

H4.at_observation_boundary: right_censored_runtime_no_cap; INCOMPLETE; never force-close or exclude

accounting.entry_and_market_exit: taker with slip-v1 and adverse tick rounding
accounting.partial_and_target: taker with slip-v1 and adverse tick rounding; no maker assumption
accounting.funding: actual signed event rate times causal mark and quantity held at that event
accounting.risk_denominator: original executed quantity times actual tick-rounded fill-to-initial-stop distance
accounting.completeness: any missing bar, slippage history, funding rate/mark, next open, or administrative censor is INCOMPLETE
